meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 把你自己的 cmem.ai 凭据(同步令牌、user id、SyncHub URL)写进 claude-mem-cowork 插件的 config.json,让 hooks 能捕获和注入记忆;可选也写入本地 ~/.claude-mem/settings.json,并用脱敏输出验证配置是否生效。
howto.when: 当你说要设置或配对 claude-mem、连接 cmem、添加 cmem key、在 Cowork 里设置云同步,或直接提供 cmem.ai Connect 里的同步令牌、user id、SyncHub URL 时触发。

say.text: 帮我配置 claude-mem,这是 cmem 同步令牌:cm_xxx
say.note: 令牌会被写进 config.json,不会回显

say.text: 把 cmem.ai Connect 里的三个值写进 claude-mem 配置
跑下 cmem-hook status,看凭据配好没有
say.note: 返回脱敏状态,MISSING 说明没写进去

howto.what_en: Sets cmem.ai credentials (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) in the claude-mem-cowork plugin's config.json so hooks can capture and inject memory. Optionally also writes them to ~/.claude-mem/settings.json and verifies with a masked status check.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to set up or pair claude-mem, connect cmem, add your cmem key, or provide cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL).

say_en.text: Set up claude-mem for me, here is my cmem sync token: cm_xxx
say_en.note: Token goes into config.json, never echoed

say_en.text: Write the three cmem.ai Connect values into my claude-mem config
Run cmem-hook status and check my credentials
say_en.note: Masked output; MISSING means the write failed
